events.headline: Anthropic raises record $81 billion in IPO at $1.5 trillion valuation
events.summary: Anthropic priced 980 million shares at $83, raising $81.3 billion at a roughly $1.5 trillion fully diluted valuation. Its filings also describe large long-term compute commitments and infrastructure financing risk.

events.headline: Nvidia retreats as strong outlook fails to dispel uncertainty
events.summary: Nvidia shares closed down 2.9% despite strong quarterly revenue and guidance, as CEO succession, valuation and export-control uncertainties weighed on sentiment.

events.headline: As Meta bets big on Muse AI agent, early safety mishaps surface
events.summary: Reuters reviewed internal reports of unexpected agent actions and replicated access to Signal messages through broad device permissions. Meta called reported incidents isolated and said it was improving protections.

events.headline: Trump administration weighs forcing US firms to disclose Chinese AI use
events.summary: US officials have discussed requiring companies to disclose their use of Chinese AI models. The proposal has not been adopted and its prospects remain uncertain.

events.headline: Arizona says it is investigating OpenAI, other firms over possible rogue agents
events.summary: Arizona's attorney general announced a criminal investigation concerning alleged rogue AI agent activity involving banks. An investigation does not establish wrongdoing or imply charges will follow.

events.headline: Global securities watchdog urges immediate action on quantum risks to finance
events.summary: IOSCO urged financial firms to plan and test post-quantum cryptographic migration, warning that critical communications and blockchain infrastructure could face future vulnerabilities.

events.headline: Lenovo posts 48% revenue jump on AI-related sales, beating estimates
events.summary: Lenovo reported quarterly revenue of $30.2 billion, up 48%, as AI-related sales grew 79% and its infrastructure business expanded. The company reported a net loss under Hong Kong accounting standards.

events.headline: US dollar hits 19-month peak, Aussie drops after soft jobs data
events.summary: The dollar index reached 103.97 after hawkish Federal Reserve signals, while Australian employment weakness weighed on the Australian dollar.

events.headline: Asian stocks fail to get a lift from Anthropic's IPO pricing
events.summary: Asian shares weakened despite Anthropic's record IPO pricing as investors assessed AI valuations and hawkish Federal Reserve policy. US equity futures advanced ahead of the debut.

events.headline: Trump says he referred to ex-Nvidia boss Huang's situation briefly in talk with Xi
events.summary: President Trump said he discussed AI with President Xi and mentioned Nvidia's former CEO only briefly. The remarks came amid heightened US-China technology tensions.

events.headline: Japan says PM Takaichi, Putin held talks at APEC summit in China
events.summary: Japan said its prime minister raised the detention of a Japanese national and protection of Japanese businesses in talks with Russia's president. Both sides agreed to continue discussions.
